headline: Cedarville score at last and take their first win
dek: Cedarville had not scored all season until Ohio Dominican visited on Thursday, when two goals from two different scorers brought their first win. The defence is still the concern: they have conceded six, and have drawn once and lost three times.
displaced_by: Cedarville, goalless all season, scored twice and beat Ohio Dominican on Sep 10; the standing dek said they had yet to score.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Eight different scorers have shared Lake Erie's nine goals, the attack spread wider than any other in the conference, yet they have conceded six and lost as often as they have won.

wire.line: Findlay are the only unbeaten side left, and Cedarville, goalless until this week, have now scored and won.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown is the other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ohio Dominican have conceded eleven goals, more than any other programme, and have won once, drawn twice and lost twice while scoring seven.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tiffin have scored eight and conceded four, and have lost only once, at home to Charleston on the opening day.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thomas More have won three and lost two, and Thursday's win at Malone was their first away from home after defeats at Trevecca and Point Park.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Brandyn Bowden has made twenty saves for Ohio Dominican and been beaten eleven times, a save percentage of .645.

last_match.line: Cedarville had not scored all season before this; Ohio Dominican have still not kept a clean sheet.

next_match.line: Thomas More have won every match at home this season, and Lake Erie have failed to score only once, at Indianapolis.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
